source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Professional accountability, meaning responsibility for nursing decisions, actions, and outcomes","B":"Delegation alone, meaning the nurse transfers all responsibility to another member of the team","C":"Professional detachment, meaning clinical decisions carry no individual responsibility afterward","D":"Avoidance of independent judgment so responsibility always remains with another licensed clinician"}}
source_row.rationale: Professional accountability refers to a nurse's acceptance of responsibility for their own actions, clinical decisions, and the outcomes of those decisions, a foundational concept in professional nursing practice reflected in codes of ethics, scope of practice standards, and licensure requirements.
source_row.source_detail: ANA Code of Ethics: professional accountability and responsibility for nursing judgments/actions; reviewed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: ANA Code of Ethics for Nurses — Professional Accountability
